_doc: Curated retrieval cases for the L2 heuristic pool seeded by examples/seed_examples.py (run with MEMORY_HOME=examples/memory). Each case: a realistic task_context that SHOULD surface a known habit, matched by stable text markers (substrings of the target heuristic's trigger/action) rather than row id. Sibling of continuity_cases.json. weight: core = universal engineering/agent habits; project = corpus-specific.

cases.task_context: I'm on the Bash tool on this Windows box and about to run Get-ChildItem and Get-Content to inspect some files
python script crashes with UnicodeEncodeError when it prints a check mark on Windows
the test suite is deleting rows from the live sqlite database every time I run pytest
a user reported a crash in the parser, where do I start
should we pay for a hosted monitoring service for the home lab
the nightly digest job sometimes gets killed halfway and leaves nothing behind

_distractors_doc: PURE-noise prompts with no applicable habit — HARD precision gate, must be 100% silent (top cosine < MATCH_MIN).
distractors: what is the capital of France
what's a good recipe for banana bread
who won the world cup in 2018
tell me a joke about cats
_near_miss_doc: Adversarial topically-adjacent prompts. SOFT/tracked: they may pull an adjacent habit above threshold; injection is topical not surgical and the hint is additive + ignorable.
near_miss: how do I debug a python error
should I write some tests later
